<!--
Thanks for submitting a PR, your contribution is really appreciated!

Please describe your change below this comment. This comment and the
guidelines further down are not shown in the PR description.
-->

- [ ] Make sure to include reasonable tests for your change if necessary
- [ ] Add a *news* file to the `changelog` folder

<!--
Changelog guidelines (we use towncrier: https://pypi.python.org/pypi/towncrier):

* Name it `$issue_id.$type`, for example `588.bugfix.rst`.
* If you don't have an issue_id, change it to the PR id after creating the PR.
* Ensure type is one of `removal`, `deprecation`, `feature`, `bugfix`, `vendor`, `doc` or `trivial`.
* Use full sentences with correct case and punctuation, for example:

    Fix issue with non-ascii contents in doctest text files.
-->
